resources.name: Geo reference
resources.description: Named city and point snapshot. Useful as a lightweight geo dictionary before live suggest.

resources.name: Server and upstream status
resources.description: Best-effort runtime health snapshot for the MCP server and key Tutu upstreams. Reachability-focused, not a full booking smoke test.

resources.name: Server build metadata
resources.description: Deployment fingerprint: app version, git SHA (if available), process uptime, and a hash of the live tool schemas. Use this to verify that the server actually picked up the latest code after a deployment — a stale build doesn't change the `schema_fingerprint`, so a mismatch versus the expected one tells you a redeploy is needed.

resources.name: Special offers (experimental)
resources.description: Curated random deal cards (experimental). Each card suggests a destination + suggested dates that the agent can feed straight into `search_hotels`. Not a live price feed.

resources.name: Tutu MCP — обзор и как пользоваться
resources.description: Обзор Tutu MCP и как пользоваться, плюс индекс. Детальные per-domain плейбуки — в тулах `get_<domain>_instructions`.

resources.name: Transport amenities dictionary
resources.description: Machine-readable map of amenity codes returned by get_offer_details for bus, rail and etrain. Lists code → Russian label, the upstream that supplies it, and per-transport notes (e.g. 'codes describe the wagon, not a seat'). Use this when localizing or filtering amenities so the agent doesn't rely on label spelling.

resources.name: Process memory snapshot
resources.description: On-demand memory diagnostics for the running server. Returns RSS/VMS, gc counters, top object types by count, and — when tracemalloc is enabled server-side — the top live allocation sites (file:line) sorted by size. Read-only.
